message: Hi, I'm a student with a information security certification background. My overall academic average is 81.6% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in data engineering and system developer. I want to become a Software Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 13200 per year. I live in Mumbai. I'm open to anywhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in data engineering and system developer roles
Has an information security certification background

explanation:
This MTech Computer Science program in Pune is highly recommended due to its excellent job prospects. With a placement rate of 93% and a median starting salary of $19239, it strongly aligns with your goal of becoming a Software Developer. The curriculum focuses on software engineering, directly matching your career interests. You must ensure you meet the requirement for a CS background, but given your IT/CS degree, this is likely achievable.

This MSc Software Quality Engineering program offers the best job security and highest salary among the options provided. It boasts a remarkable placement rate of 95% and a median starting salary of $21062. While focused on QA testing, this role is integral to software development quality and systems, making it highly relevant to your career goals. The tuition fee is also manageable at $3500.

This MTech Data Engineering program in Kolkata provides exceptional job outcomes with a placement rate of 95% and a strong median starting salary of $19658. It directly addresses your interest in data engineering while maintaining high employability. Since the minimum grade required is 82%, your current academic average of 81.6% is very close, making this a top-tier option if you can meet the minor requirement gap.

This MSc Data Science program in Mumbai perfectly matches your location preference while offering strong job prospects. It has a placement rate of 87% and a median starting salary of $13436, providing a good balance between career goals and geographical convenience. Since you have an IT/CS background, meeting the CS requirement is straightforward, making this a reliable choice.

This MTech Computer Networks program in Pune offers robust training in systems and networking, which complements your interest in system development. It maintains a solid placement rate of 83% and a median starting salary of $15192. The tuition is relatively low at $2050, making it an affordable option that still promises strong career outcomes.
